title: Satin with a feathered edge stays a sawtooth
description: A 20 × 5 mm rectangle in satin at 90°, density 3, without under sewing, with a 3 mm feathered edge on the side of its start point (the middle of the bottom edge), must be sewn as PE-DESIGN 11.50 sews it: the split sawtooth of satin-zigzag-rect, each row's starting end moved in by a fixed repeating pattern of shares of the feather width.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-feather.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): 75 stitches; rows 0.7 mm apart from each end to the start point, sewn from the bottom edge up; the bottom ends of all rows but each half's first and last move up by 0.9, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.1, 0.6, 0.3, 0.8, 0, 0.7, 0.4 × 3 mm, the pattern restarting in each half. OpenStitch places the start point with object.setEntryExit (it has no per-shape default yet).

references.make: On a 100 x 100 mm Design Page draw a rectangle 20 mm wide and 5 mm high at (10, 10) mm. Line Not Sewn; region Satin Stitch, Direction 90°, Density 3.0, Under Sewing off, Feathered Edge on (3.0 mm on the first row), other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-feather.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): the feathered row ends lie between the edges.
PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-feather.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): the longest stitches are the 5 mm crossings and their 5.05 mm slants.
